notes.title: Update Notes - 05/14/2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/d73a6a70c774478715977be74703f45eb97e2807.png[/img]
2025/05/14 Patch Note
[list]
[*] The player's base movement speed has been increased from 6.5 to 10.
[*] The upgrade cost for increasing gold acquisition in the base has been reduced.
[*] In base upgrades, movement speed now increases by 5% per level, up to a maximum of 25%.
[*] In missions, upgrade cards for movement speed now grant a 5% increase per level, up to a maximum of 25%.
[*] The HP of elite enemies in some stages has been reduced.
[*] The amount of gold earned after winning a stage has been increased.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - 02/10/2025
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support!
We have received a lot of valuable feedback and have started optimizing.
Here is an update on two key issues:

2025/02/10 Patch Note
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the display was incorrect when using a widescreen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Limit Break" achievement could not be unlocked.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - 12/11/2024
notes.content:
2024/12/11 Patch Note
[list]
[*] Added character voiceovers.
[*] Fixed some localization texts.
[*] Optimized the floor textures in the first level scene.
[*] Improved the UI interface for level selection.
[*] Fixed the issue where enemies continued spawning after the boss was defeated.
[*] Fixed the issue where invincible status prevented players from picking up health packs.
[/list]

notes.title: October 09 Update Notes & New Trailer Release
notes.content:
[h3]"Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" will participate in the Steam Next Fest starting on October 15. The demo has been updated on the game’s Steam page, and a new trailer has been released. Players can experience the latest version, featuring all difficulty levels of the first stage and unlocking the BOSS character—Eve.[/h3]

[h3]We’ve also released the latest trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=NeTGLtleh_U;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44817509/4dba78e578017e398f2582005367ecf8e73881c9.png[/img]
(The demo includes the newly unlockable BOSS character—Eve)

[h3]The current version has improved UI, game balance, and added character animations. We will continue internal testing and optimization. Future updates will include character voiceovers and other planned features. Interested players, please follow our official channels and add "Valkyrie Squad: Siege Breakers" to your Steam wishlist![/h3]

2024/10/09 Patch Note
[list]
[*] Adjust and optimize some UI elements
[*] Add a fifth difficulty level
[*] Add new character unlocks
[*] Optimize enemy collision warning box
[*] Add supply crate indicator arrows
[*] Add evolution weapon synthesis hint interface
[*] Add 3-second invincibility after revival
[*] Balance stage difficulty
[*] Change mouse cursor design
[*] Adjust base upgrades and character enhancement values and required money
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692030

2024/02/29 Patch Note

[*] Added initial gameplay tutorial.
[*] Added "Tutorial" page in settings.
